newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 5.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On the Wall Street, the Dow Jones industrial average rose by 95 points to 7,071 on Friday.
* Japanese, U.S. funds expected to continue buying after Friday's program. On Friday, the blue-chip Composite Index closed 17.79 points at 1,097.96.
* Selling by many "stale bulls", those holding on to shares bought at higher levels, could upset a possible rally.
* Focus on Rahman Hydraulics, which announced a changes in board of directors.
* Blue-chips could expect a boost from continued foreign buying, analysts say
* Tenaga expected to lead any blue-chip gains after last week's 8.3 percent hike in electricity tariff announced by the government.

* Berjaya Group may be hit by decision to sell 80 percent of Berjaya Singer at what analysts say is a low price. Berjaya Singer shares are being sold at 5.3 ringgit each or a total 1.19 billion ringgit. "That is bad news for Berjaya Group," said Ralph Dixon of TA Securities' international division.
